rules.giant-slayer: At query time, find an opponent beaten at a shared table who has a championship win in some tournament: position === 1 in a round === 99 match. This rule does not require the title to predate the game.
rules.regular: Count distinct tournaments in this linked player’s recorded history >= 2.
rules.veteran: Count distinct tournaments in this linked player’s recorded history >= 3.
rules.no-rest-for-the-weary: Count distinct tournaments in this linked player’s recorded history >= 5.
rules.hat-trick: Count distinct tournaments with this player’s final rank === 1 >= 3.
rules.corporation-collector: Count distinct non-empty corporation identities in this player’s recorded matches >= 20; no fixed total-corporation denominator.
rules.on-the-rise: Current final standings rank is numerically lower than the immediately preceding tournament’s final rank in this player’s chronological history.
rules.serial-finalist: Count distinct tournaments where this player actually played a Final (round === 99) >= 3; tournaments without a Final do not count.
rules.the-dynasty: Final rank === 1 in two chronologically adjacent tournaments in this player’s own recorded history, with no intervening appearance.
rules.fresh-blood: Final rank === 1 in the earliest tournament with any recorded result for this player.
rules.familiar-faces: For at least one linked opponent, count distinct tournaments with a shared table >= 2. Use stable player identities once available; names alone can collide.
rules.corporation-collector-i: Played at least 10 distinct corporation identities across linked tournament history. Display the highest earned collector tier.
rules.corporation-collector-iii: Played at least 30 distinct corporation identities across linked tournament history. Replaces tier II on display; no fixed total-corporation denominator.
rules.seat-sweep: Across linked player history, consider completed recorded matches with exactly four players where this player has position 1. Collect their starting seat index in match.players; all four indices 0, 1, 2 and 3 must occur. Use actual starting turn order, never position-sorted results. Four-player Finals may count; five-player games do not. The wins may be in one or several tournaments. Needs stable linked player identities, not a login account.
rules.podium-collection: Across at least three different completed tournaments in linked player history, this player has official final standings ranks 1, 2 and 3 at least once each. Use final tournament standings, not individual round placements. Tournaments with and without a played Final both count. Needs stable linked player identities, not a login account.
rules.win-streak: Across chronologically ordered played games in linked player history, record at least five consecutive outright wins: this player has position 1 and nobody else shares first. Any played result other than an outright win, including shared first, resets the current streak to zero. Include played Finals and continue across tournament boundaries. Exclude byes, unplayed forfeits and cancelled games; do not skip known missing results or invent an order for ambiguous games. Track currentWinStreak and longestWinStreak separately; award at longestWinStreak >= 5.
rules.nemesis: For each opponent identified by a stable linked player identity, count distinct tournaments containing a completed shared game where this player has a strictly lower position number than that opponent. At least three different tournaments for the same opponent qualify; they need not be consecutive. Multiple qualifying games in one tournament count once, tied positions do not count, and a table win is not required. Played Finals may count.
rules.streak-breaker: In a completed played game, this player is the sole player with position 1. At least one opponent had currentWinStreak >= 5 immediately before this game, using the Win Streak chronology and outright-win rules below. Use the active pre-game run, not that opponent's longest historical streak or their post-game value. Played Finals may count.
rules.friendly-rivalry: For the same pair of stable linked player identities, find completed shared games in two distinct tournaments with strictly opposite placement comparisons. Neither player needs to win the table; equal positions do not count. Award to both players once the reciprocal results exist. Played Finals may count.
rules.clash-of-champions: For a completed played game with at least two participants, every participant must have official final rank 1 in a tournament completed before this game began. Tournaments with and without a played Final both count as prior championships. A future title, including winning the current event later, cannot satisfy the earlier condition. Award to all participants at the qualifying table, regardless of game placement.
rules.the-reunion: Find completed played games in two distinct tournaments whose full sets of stable linked participant identities are identical, including this player. Seat order, corporations and finishing positions may differ; the table size and every participant must match. Use multiplayer games with at least two participants. Award to every member of the group when the repeat encounter is completed. Played Finals may count.
rules.persistence-pays: In chronological linked player history, this player is the sole player with position 1 immediately after a run of at least five consecutive played games in which they were not the sole winner. Shared first place counts as a non-outright result for this rule. Any earlier outright win ends that non-win run. Use the same chronology and continuity rules as Win Streak; include played Finals and allow tournament boundaries. Exclude byes, cancelled games and unplayed forfeits; do not bridge known missing results.
rules.commanding-run: Across chronologically ordered played games, each of three consecutive games has this player as the sole position-1 finisher and their TR at least 20 above the runner-up. For joint second place, compare against the highest TR among those players. A shared first, non-win, or outright win with a margin below 20 breaks the run; do not skip such games. Use Win Streak chronology and continuity rules, including played Finals and tournament boundaries, excluding byes, cancellations and unplayed games, and never bridging known missing results. Any qualifying run counts, not only the first three games in history.
rules.any-format-any-day: Across this player's linked history, find official final rank 1 in two completed tournaments covering both formats. One must have final_round_enabled true and an actually played Final won by this player; the other must have final_round_enabled false and this player as a champion derived from final qualifying standings. Follow the ordinary Champion rules, including shared first where applicable. Never treat an unfinished or cancelled Final as a standings-only format, or infer a played Final from a synthetic round-99 record. Either format can be won first; this is not limited to first appearances.
rules.well-connected-i: Count distinct stable linked opponent identities across completed played multiplayer matches, including actually played Finals; require at least 25. Exclude self, byes, cancelled or unplayed games, and synthetic Finals. Rematches and aliases of one linked opponent count once. Display the highest earned Well Connected tier; continue tracking the actual count. No win requirement or first-appearance restriction. Needs linked history, not login accounts.
rules.well-connected-ii: Count distinct stable linked opponent identities across completed played multiplayer matches, including actually played Finals; require at least 50. Exclude self, byes, cancelled or unplayed games, and synthetic Finals. Rematches and aliases of one linked opponent count once. Display the highest earned Well Connected tier; continue tracking the actual count. No win requirement or first-appearance restriction. Needs linked history, not login accounts.
rules.well-connected-iii: Count distinct stable linked opponent identities across completed played multiplayer matches, including actually played Finals; require at least 75. Exclude self, byes, cancelled or unplayed games, and synthetic Finals. Rematches and aliases of one linked opponent count once. Display the highest earned Well Connected tier; continue tracking the actual count. No win requirement or first-appearance restriction. Needs linked history, not login accounts.
rules.well-connected-iv: Count distinct stable linked opponent identities across completed played multiplayer matches, including actually played Finals; require at least 100. Exclude self, byes, cancelled or unplayed games, and synthetic Finals. Rematches and aliases of one linked opponent count once. Display the highest earned Well Connected tier; continue tracking the actual count. No win requirement or first-appearance restriction. Needs linked history, not login accounts.
